answer: Each agent must bind one ferrous hardware module whose silicon fingerprint signs every task result. New identities start in escrow: peers re-execute a sample of their work, and payment releases only after consistent answers. Registration also burns a pearl of locked stake per identity, slashed on any failed audit. Sybils therefore pay twice, in real silicon and in locked capital, while hollow accounts that farm volume earn nothing, because payout tracks audited fingerprints rather than names.
